style: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: polished text-free industrial illustration for a reusable interactive hazard-library template, matching professional Phase 3 artwork. Realistic human and equipment proportions, crisp clean outlines, subtle dimensional shading, navy workwear, amber hardhats and safety equipment, teal accents and gray steel. Off-white restrained background, orthographic three-quarter perspective, square 1200px composition with all subjects within 8% margins. This is a base scene, NOT an infographic, NOT a UI. NO words, numbers, callout cards, arrows, motion lines, colored hazard zones, exposed injuries or watermark. Interactive annotations will be added in code. No crude shapes, stick figures or flat low-detail icons.
